cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Consequences Compound
cards.instruction: Make each new choice carry a larger reward, cost, audience, or point of no return.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our table-tennis rematch decides who cleans up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can serve first. Winner sets the cleaning method for the whole year.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You write the terms, then. I'll bring the whole club to witness us agreeing.

reason: Grant B serve and wording control while escalating a cleanup game into annual policy and public commitment, preserving actual B objection as cause.
